items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: And another time he put somebody down was Mel Torme, was Berlin on drums.

ctx.x: And another time he put somebody down was Mel Torme, was Berlin on drums. And he kept saying, Mickey Rooney, Mickey Rooney.

Yeah. I didn't know him well. You did, but I never could tell -- if he felt like it, he could talk about classical music, about political stuff, but I don't know if he really cared about it. It was just kind of a put-on. Was he very intelligent?
